task:
Set up Playwright e2e tests for the 3D pool game. Do the following steps IN ORDER:

STEP 1: Install Playwright as a dev dependency:
npm install -D @playwright/test
npx playwright install chromium

STEP 2: Create playwright.config.ts in the project root:
- Test against http://localhost:5173 (dev server)
- Use chromium only
- Set timeout to 30000ms
- webServer config: command 'npm run dev', port 5173, reuseExistingServer true

STEP 3: Create e2e/ directory and write these test files:

File: e2e/rendering.spec.ts
- Test: 'canvas renders on page load' - visit /, assert canvas element exists
- Test: 'GameUI overlay is present' - assert div with game status info is visible
- Test: 'page title contains pool' - check document title

File: e2e/game-logic.spec.ts
- Test: 'game starts with Player 1' - check text contains 'Player 1'
- Test: 'keyboard R resets game' - press R key, verify game resets
- Test: 'keyboard T toggles camera' - press T key, verify no errors
- Test: 'keyboard U undo shows no errors' - press U key, verify no console errors

File: e2e/build.spec.ts
- Test: 'build succeeds' - use shell to run 'npm run build' and check exit code 0 (this can be a simple script test, not a Playwright test - put it in a separate script or just skip this one since we know build works)

IMPORTANT: For all Playwright tests:
- Use page.goto('/') to navigate
- Use page.waitForSelector('canvas') to wait for 3D render
- Use page.locator() for finding elements
- Add proper waits (the 3D scene needs time to initialize)
- Handle the fact that GameUI elements may use aria-label attributes

STEP 4: Run the tests:
npx playwright test --reporter=line

Report the test results.
